critique.evidence: Strong cyber-lab art direction, crisp typography, disciplined cyan/red palette, and a clear headline-to-evidence hierarchy across viewports. However, desktop leaves excessive inert space below the hero, tablet connectors terminate awkwardly and make the card layout feel loose, and mobile loses the visual storytelling entirely by reducing the flow to an ordinary card stack. The global header is especially cramped at tablet/mobile: labels visibly clip, the mobile brand becomes icon-only, and the tiny low-contrast navigation weakens polish. Contrast proof is also incomplete for 1 tablet and 12 mobile header links.
critique.fix: Tighten desktop vertical composition; rebuild the tablet/mobile evidence flow with deliberate connector alignment or a clear vertical timeline; simplify the responsive header into an intentional compact menu while retaining the brand; and raise nav-label contrast with a solid, testable background.
